changelog: New Retreat option in Settings ends a run on your terms — it's logged as a defeat, but you keep every stat, record and merit just like any other loss. The boss briefing now fits the screen in landscape (portrait on the left, intel on the right), and the selected-unit panel can slide to either side of the board with its new arrows so it never covers the fight. Enemies left with nothing to do now dig in and recover a little health, the objective hold-point keeps a glowing ring even while you're standing on it, and battle toasts drop down beside your hand in landscape. Fixes: campaign rename, the medal detail layout, storm icons bleeding onto your cards or lingering on remembered ground, and a tidied-up War Cry description.
